title: Lawrence, KS — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lawrence, KS: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lawrence is a city in KS with a population of 98,000. Home of the University of Kansas with a vibrant music scene and historic downtown. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 29.2.
